relations.rationale: Gus calling out scores after each round could prompt Nell's joking reaction about her team's performance, but this is only weakly implied.
Gus calling out scores has no logical bearing on Esme's separate activity of chatting with servers.
Gus calling scores after each round sets up a pattern that would culminate in tallying final scores and reactions, supporting the final scene.
Nell checking her tally could naturally lead to her joking comment about her team's knowledge, showing a plausible causal link.
Nell checking her team's tally is a small individual action unrelated to the collective reaction at final tallying.
Palpable tension in the final round directly supports the description of teams whispering strategies and double-checking answers.
High tension by the final round supports the idea that the final score reveal would produce strong emotional reactions like cheers and groans.
Teams whispering strategies is unrelated to Esme's separate activity of chatting with servers about turnout.
Teams intensely strategizing and double-checking answers supports the idea that final results would provoke strong mixed reactions.
Esme chatting about the turnout naturally supports her being pleased at how full the room became, as both relate to her awareness of attendance.
Esme's pleasure at the full room supports the notion that the night was lively and successful.
Mixed cheers and groans at the final tally directly support the characterization of the night as lively.
